snippet.title: Langrisser: Sea of Sword - First Gameplay Trailer | Wishlist Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Visit the Langrisser: Sea of Sword Steam store page now and add it to your wishlist:
🔗 Steam Store Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4808030

This time, we have broken away from the rigid framework of traditional linear stage progression and evolved the game into a strategy RPG experience built around both tactical depth and free exploration. 
Developed by BlackJack Studio, the original Langrisser Mobile team,
with all-new music by world-renowned composer Yasunori Nishiki.

Pre-registration is now open across all platforms. Tap here to pre-register: 🔗Pre-registration Link: https://ll.game-tree.com/

Stay tuned to our official community for more Langrisser: Sea of Sword news and updates!
Discord: https://discord.gg/Wukgzve6kb
X: https://x.com/LLSeaofswordEN
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LangrisserSeaofSword/
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/LangrisserSeaofSword/
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@langrisserseaofsworden

#LangrisserSeaOfSword #Langrisser #SRPG #TacticalRPG #Steam #JRPG
